Name: MoreMultiplayerInfo (1.6 Updated)
Author: yummypecho
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[i]
Another absolutely fantastic mod! I've risen it from da ded. Updated to 1.6.3+!!![/i]

Meant to be a revival fix, so bugs do persist. Do let me know of course ^^

Few notes / known issues:
[list]
[*]Modifying the config in the in-game settings might not work properly[/*]
[*]Health/energy might not work properly. idk i didnt code it[/*]
[*]Health/energy bars positions can be offset (to the right) inside config file [ run the mod once to create this ][/*]
[*]ShowYourself is toggleable in the config file / upper left corner of a player's info. This makes it so that u are included as characters in the right cuz its cute that u see urself there-[/*]
[/list]Compatible with Fashion Sense (your side icons will show custom hair / faces).

Here's where you can view / add on my code: [url=https://github.com/shankencedric/StardewValleyMods-stardewsteak]https://github.com/shankencedric/StardewValleyMods-stardewsteak[/url] 

[b]Original Description (from CheesySteak)
[/b]
[list]
[*]Adds a list of the other players on the right side of the screen. [/*]
[*]View Player Information (all updated in real-time!) such as: Inventory, Skill Levels, Current Location, Last Activity (including tool use, area changes, cutscenes, and more).[/*]
[*]Configurable Options to disable certain messages, hide stuff if playing single player, and toggle visibility of certain items in the player information screen.[/*]
[/list]
Source is available here: https://github.com/cheesysteak/stardew-steak
